headline: Smartphone shipments in Mexico fell 26% in the third quarter of 2026
summary: Smartphone shipments in Mexico fell 26% in the third quarter of 2026. Counterpoint Research expects memory chip shortages to hit sub-$250 phones hardest in 2026.
why: Smartphone shipments track consumer demand and component supply, affecting handset makers, chipmakers and retailers. Memory chips are a key cost input for consumer electronics.
original_headline: Los envíos de smartphones en México cayeron 26% en el tercer trimestre de 2026
